Reply_Accession.description: A reference sequence accession: RefSeq or Ensembl with its version, or LRG.

Reply_Build.description: The assembly stated by the source; no default is inferred.

x-enum-descriptions: A source category of oncogenic mutations, without classifying a member.
Every variant at a stated protein site.

Reply_ClinVarAlleleId.description: An allele identifier inside a ClinVar record, not a variant identifier.

Reply_ClinVarVariationId.description: A ClinVar variation record, which may represent a compound.

Reply_ClinvarHaplotypeMember.description: One source-stated member of a native ClinVar haplotype.

Reply_Coding.description: A code in one explicitly named source framework.

Reply_EnsemblGeneId.description: A human Ensembl gene stable identifier with a separately retained version.

Reply_GeneRef.description: A source-stated gene reference; its label never implies an identifier.

Reply_GeneSymbol.description: Source spelling of a gene symbol, with ASCII case-insensitive identity.

Reply_HgncId.description: An HGNC identifier with canonical namespace and positive numeric value.

Reply_HgvsText.description: Reference-qualified notation with its original text, without a molecular parse.

Reply_NcbiGeneId.description: A positive NCBI Gene identifier in canonical decimal text.

Reply_PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Reply_PopulationSex.description: Sex stratum stated by a population source.

Reply_Position1.description: A positive one-based position, without an assembly or biological meaning.

Reply_ProfileExpression.description: Exact source text together with its parsed Boolean tree.

Reply_ProfileNode.description: Source-stated Boolean relations. No node implies same-allele phase.

oneOf.description: Every operand is required by the source expression.

Reply_ProteinSite.description: A residue or residue interval, without a variant assertion.

end.description: Last one-based residue, if a range.

transcript.description: Source transcript, with version status kept.

Reply_Region.description: A numbered exon or intron with its stated total.

Reply_RegionKind.description: An exon or intron in a source transcript annotation.

Reply_SymbolGeneRef.description: One gene label and the publisher identifiers known for it.

Reply_Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

Reply_TranscriptReference.description: A transcript reference in versioned Accession or unversioned AccessionBase form.

Reply_VariantId.description: Published variant-level identifiers, with each identifier's level retained.

Reply_VariantRef.description: Checked source subject reference; at least one source identity or label is required.

oneOf.description: Exact allele identifier or reference-qualified notation.
Native ClinVar haplotype and its complete source member identities.

members.description: Complete member identities in native order.

oneOf.description: Native source variant with optional source-stated forms.
Compound source profile, without inferred allele identity or phase.

expression.description: Exact source expression and checked member relations.

members.description: Source member references in their native order.

Reply_VcvId.description: A ClinVar variation accession, possibly a haplotype or compound.

description: One checked stratum of one source dataset release.
